import { z } from "zod";
import { DatabaseSync } from "node:sqlite";

//#region src/errors.d.ts
declare class StorageError extends Error {
  readonly code: string;
  readonly status: number;
  readonly details: Record<string, unknown>;
  constructor(code: string, status: number, message: string, details?: Record<string, unknown>);
}
//#endregion
//#region src/repo-file-protocol.d.ts
declare const repoFileReadArgs: z.ZodObject<{
  workspaceRef: z.ZodString;
  baseCommit: z.ZodString;
  path: z.ZodString;
  offset: z.ZodDefault<z.ZodNumber>;
  length: z.ZodDefault<z.ZodNumber>;
}, z.core.$strict>;
declare const repoWriteFileArgs: z.ZodObject<{
  workspaceRef: z.ZodString;
  baseCommit: z.ZodString;
  path: z.ZodString;
  expectedSha256: z.ZodNullable<z.ZodString>;
  text: z.ZodString;
}, z.core.$strict>;
declare const repoDeleteFileArgs: z.ZodObject<{
  workspaceRef: z.ZodString;
  baseCommit: z.ZodString;
  path: z.ZodString;
  expectedSha256: z.ZodString;
}, z.core.$strict>;
declare const repoFileProof: z.ZodObject<{
  directories: z.ZodArray<z.ZodObject<{
    path: z.ZodString;
    device: z.ZodString;
    fileId: z.ZodString;
  }, z.core.$strict>>;
  file: z.ZodObject<{
    path: z.ZodString;
    device: z.ZodString;
    fileId: z.ZodString;
  }, z.core.$strict>;
  sha256: z.ZodString;
  byteSize: z.ZodNumber;
}, z.core.$strict>;
interface RepoFileOperation {
  operationId: string;
  toolName: 'repo.writeFile' | 'repo.deleteFile';
  requestHash: string;
  state: string;
  cleanupConfirmed: boolean;
  scope: string[];
  request: {
    args: z.output<typeof repoWriteFileArgs> | z.output<typeof repoDeleteFileArgs>;
    binding: z.output<typeof repoBinding>;
  };
  proof: z.output<typeof repoFileProof> | null;
  result: Record<string, unknown> | null;
}
//#endregion
//#region src/lock.d.ts
declare function acquireWriterLock(databasePath: string, recoveryToken?: string): {
  path: string;
  token: `${string}-${string}-${string}-${string}-${string}`;
  release(): void;
};
//#endregion
//#region src/workspace-preservation-domain.d.ts
declare function workspacePreservationMaterialKey(path: string): string;
//#endregion
//#region src/index.d.ts
interface StorageOptions {
  databasePath: string;
  storeId: string;
  layoutVersion?: 1;
  create?: boolean;
  backupDirectory?: string;
  recoveryToken?: string;
  targetVersion?: number;
  queueCapacity?: number;
}
declare class SqliteStorage {
  #private;
  readonly ready: Promise<void>;
  constructor(options: StorageOptions);
  request<M extends Method>(method: M, payload: Request<M>): Promise<Results[M]>;
  close(): Promise<void>;
  /** Deliberate emergency shutdown. In-flight writes remain OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. */
  terminate(): Promise<void>;
}
declare function openStorage(options: StorageOptions): Promise<SqliteStorage>;
//#endregion
